name: What is the typical cost range for a pool renovation in Los Angeles?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost range for a pool renovation in Los Angeles?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a pool renovation in Los Angeles varies significantly based on the scope of work, materials chosen, and the size and complexity of your pool. A basic replastering might start from $5,000 to $10,000, while a comprehensive renovation including new decking, equipment upgrades, and added features could range from $30,000 to over $100,000. Factors like structural repairs, plumbing overhauls, or adding advanced automation will increase the overall investment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs for pool renovation in Los Angeles vary widely, from $5,000 for basic replastering to over $100,000 for comprehensive projects including new decking and equipment.
